name: Hex
tagline: AI analytics platform for data exploration
description: Hex is described as an AI analytics platform for trusted data exploration, with agentic notebooks, conversational self-serve analytics and interactive data apps.
features: Enterprise: OIDC SSO, audit logs and bring-your-own-key
useCases: Exploring and analysing data with AI help
strengths: Professional is free for students and educators (per the FAQ)
limitations: Prices are per Editor; the billing interval behind them was not stated
Community is limited to small compute and 5 published apps

free.details: Community is free: a Hex agent trial, small compute, up to 5 published apps, 7-day version history, up to 3 shared collections and 3 shared components.

pricing.trial: Team: 14 days free (no card, per the FAQ); an extended 30-day trial of Hex Team is linked.

plans.name: Professional
plans.billing: Per Editor per month; monthly versus annual billing was not stated

plans.name: Team
plans.billing: Per Editor per month; monthly versus annual billing was not stated

pricing.regional: Prices were shown in USD. Pay-as-you-go compute is available on Team and Enterprise (for example Large at $0.32 per hour).

verification.notes: Product active (Hex 4.0 announced). Community free; Professional $36 and Team $75 per editor/month (Team: 14 days free); Enterprise custom. The page does not say whether prices are monthly or annual billing, so it stays partial.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read
